whitelist_criteria.walk_forward_stability: Consistent positive expectancy across Train, Validation, and Out-of-Sample
whitelist_criteria.cost_inclusion: Real broker spread, commission, and adverse slippage included

whitelisted_strategies.audit_notes: First candidate to pass full multi-period walk-forward stability under real broker costs (spread=0.012, commission=0.005, slippage=0.003). Generated +21.57 net PnL (PF 2.04) on OOS with positive Train PnL (+0.64) and +15.87 Full PnL across 133 closed trades. Max drawdown was only 0.28%.

summary.rationale: Phase 3 regime isolation and Kalman spread Z-score calibration successfully isolated the first robustly whitelisted quantitative strategy: USDJPY M15 under MOM_ONLY Autonomous mode. Higher timeframes (H1) also transformed trend assets (NAS100 H1 OOS +382.84, BTCUSDT H1 OOS +371.75), validating that isolating momentum and filtering high-frequency noise provides positive expectancy under real market transaction costs.
